senses.gloss: (חוּר) cavernous rocks resembling human figures. Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 (ref. to Pi-Haḥiroth, Ex. XIV, 2) מה ח׳ וכ׳ what was the nature of these rocks?—They were not slanting but abrupt &c.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 14">Ib.</cite> <he>הח׳ מצד וכ׳</he> the rocks were on one side, and Migdol &c.
Ib. איו ח׳ אלא מקום חֵירוּתָן וכ׳ ḥiroth means the place of Israel’s liberty (licentiousness); Yalk. Ex. 230; Num. R. s. 20.
